انغسلن (form VII)
# اِنْغَسَلْنَ (inḡasalna) /in.ɣa.sal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# اِنْغَسِلْنَ (inḡasilna) /in.ɣa.sil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
